details: Fetches a Steam user's friends list.
By default, the data is parsed (`parsed=1`) for better readability.
For raw data directly from Steam, set `parsed=0`.
Retrieve detailed information about a user's friends, such as online status, game activity, and profile details.
Optimized for better response times by utilizing caching.
usage_notes: Provide the user's Steam ID (64-bit) or Vanity URL using the `id` parameter.
Use the `no_cache` parameter to bypass caching if real-time data is required.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key, available in the Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Steam ID (64-bit) or Steam Vanity URL. Required for identifying the user.

parameters.name: no_cache
parameters.description: Set to 1 to bypass caching. Default: Cached for 1 day for better performance. If you don't need real-time state data of the user, set no_cache=0 for faster response times.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

endpoints.description: ⚡ Fetch Detailed Steam Inventory with Pricing Data - Best API in the World!
details: 🚀 Fetch detailed Steam inventory data while bypassing rate limits.
Provides either Steam's raw response or a parsed version with item prices and metadata (controlled via `parse` parameter).
Inventory tracking for daily updates and insights.
Supports private inventories by fetching cached or fallback data when possible.
Supports Trade URL for CS2 inventories to access previously blocked items (7-10 days).
Can fetch inventory without the 10-day block using the `steam_login_secure` parameter.
usage_notes: Provide either `steam_id` or `trade_url` to identify the inventory.
Use `state` parameter to specify inventory state (active, fallback, takedb).
Use `currency` parameter to specify the currency for item prices.

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key, available in the dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: steam_id
parameters.description: The Steam ID of the user. Accepts formats: steamid, steamid3, or steamid64. Using an account name may slow the request.

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Specifies the inventory state. Options: - active (default): Fetch the current inventory. - fallback: Fetch cached data if the inventory is private or inaccessible. - takedb: Always fetch data from the database. This is faster but may provide outdated data. Cached data includes a timestamp in the response headers.

parameters.name: steam_login_secure
parameters.description: If you want take your Inventory, without 10 Days block you can send your steamloginsecure. Our System takes automaticly the inventory of the Steamloginsecure. No steam_id param need then and will be ignored.

parameters.name: game
parameters.description: Short name of the game.

parameters.name: parse
parameters.description: Enable data parsing for detailed item information.

parameters.name: language
parameters.description: Preferred language for the response.

parameters.name: no_cache
parameters.description: Bypass the default 1-day cache. This requires additional credits.

parameters.name: group
parameters.description: Group identical items. Default is 0 (duplicates are removed).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort items by a specified criterion. Options: - price_max (default): Sort by highest price. - price_min: Sort by lowest price. - count: Sort by quantity. - name: Sort alphabetically.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Specify the currency for item prices (e.g., EUR, TRY, BRL). Default is USD. Only applicable when parse is enabled.

parameters.name: select
parameters.description: Select specific item properties to include in the response. Example: markethashname,price.

parameters.name: with_no_tradable
parameters.description: Include items that are not tradable. Default is 0 (not included).

parameters.name: trade_url
parameters.description: Provide a Trade URL instead of a Steam ID. For example for the Game CS2 if you send a Trade URL, it takes the 7-10 Days blocked items too.

parameters.name: offset
parameters.description: Offset for pagination.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Limit for pagination.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

endpoints.description: 📜 Retrieve Historical Inventory Changes with Value and Item Count
details: 📜 Fetches all inventory changes for a specified game and Steam ID.
Provides details about the inventory's worth (in USD), size (number of items), and the timestamp of the change.
Tracks all historical changes in the inventory.
Calculates the total worth of items in USD (Steam market value).
Compatible with all Steam games, including CS2, Dota 2, and Rust.

Includes timestamped records to track changes over time.

endpoints.description: 👤 Retrieve a Steam User's Profile with Flexible Options
details: Fetches a Steam user profile with flexible options.
Supports detailed or minimal data retrieval based on your needs.
Use the `id` parameter to identify the profile. Supports SteamID, username, or profile URL (SteamID recommended for faster and more accurate results).
Retrieve real-time data by setting `no_cache` to `1` (slower response).
Adjust the data depth using the `state` parameter (`minimal` or `detailed`).
Optimize responses with the `force_from_db_if_exists` parameter to fetch profiles from the database if available.
usage_notes: Provide a valid `id` parameter (SteamID, profile URL, or username).
Use optional parameters to customize data retrieval (e.g., `state=detailed` for additional profile details).

parameters.name: key
parameters.description: Your API key for authentication. Retrieve it from your Dashboard (top-right corner).

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Identifier for the profile. Accepts: - SteamID (recommended for speed and accuracy). - Profile URL. - Username.

parameters.name: no_cache
parameters.description: Set to 1 to bypass the cache and fetch data directly from Steam. - Default: Cached data (faster).

parameters.name: state
parameters.description: Defines the level of profile detail: - minimal (default): Basic profile data. - detailed: Includes additional details like level, trade ban info, and friend states (slower).

parameters.name: force_from_db_if_exists
parameters.description: Set to 1 to retrieve the profile from the database if available. - If not found, fresh data will be fetched and cached automatically. - Useful for rapid responses without impacting rate limits.

parameters.name: production
parameters.description: If you run in production, please set this to 1. Default is 0. This is in future required, and if not set, you will get a warning.

responses.description: Profile retrieved successfully.
Missing required "id" parameter.
Invalid "id" parameter. Must be a SteamID, profile URL, or username.
